title: Logo Sync not working
description:
The logo sync feature is working but syncing the wrong thing.

**Current behavior:**
- Logos are being downloaded even when they have URLs

**Expected behavior:**
- Don't download logos for logos that have URLs
- Only sync over the URLs themselves

**Scope:**
- Import functionality
- Export functionality
- Sync functionality

title: No URL validation in DispatcharrClient (SSRF risk)
description: In dispatcharrClient.ts:13-24, connection.url is not validated. Could accept SSRF vectors like 'http://localhost:8000/' pointing to internal services. Should add URL validation and consider allowlisting valid URL patterns.
close_reason: Added URL validation in DispatcharrClient constructor to prevent SSRF attacks. Blocks: localhost, private IPs (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x), link-local (169.254.x), loopback (127.x), IPv6 local addresses, and cloud metadata endpoints. Added ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS=true env var to allow private network access for self-hosted/Docker setups. Non-HTTP(S) protocols always blocked.

title: Implement global toast/notification store
description: Toast handling in Jobs.svelte (lines 23-25) uses per-component state. Should implement a global Svelte store for toast management to allow any component to show notifications and ensure proper cleanup. This would also enable stacking multiple toasts.
close_reason: Implemented global toast/notification store: 1) Created toastStore.ts with Svelte writable store, auto-dismiss with configurable timeouts, convenience methods (success, error, warning, info). 2) Created ToastContainer.svelte with animations, accessibility attributes, and multiple toast types. 3) Updated App.svelte to include ToastContainer. 4) Refactored Jobs.svelte to use global store instead of per-component state, removing ~65 lines of local toast code.

title: Silent error handling in frontend log loading
description: All log loading APIs silently fail with 'ignore errors' comments. Examples: Jobs.svelte:94-97, Sync.svelte:172-174, Export.svelte:149-153, Import.svelte:305-310. This hides real problems from users who expect to see logs. Should show 'Logs unavailable' message rather than silently failing.
close_reason: Fixed silent error handling in frontend log loading. Added logsError state to Sync.svelte, Export.svelte, and Import.svelte. Added historyError state to Jobs.svelte. All components now display error messages when log/history loading fails instead of silently ignoring errors.

title: Hardcoded UI strings duplicated across components
close_reason: Created centralized constants.ts with: ERRORS (21 error message constants), SUCCESS (7 success messages), STATUS (12 status messages), LABELS (17 UI labels), VALIDATION (3 validation messages), CONFIRM (4 confirmation messages), WARNINGS (1 warning), and getErrorMessage() helper. Updated Jobs.svelte, Export.svelte, and Import.svelte to use these centralized strings. This establishes the pattern for other components and enables future i18n support.

title: Toast notifications missing role='alert'
description: Accessibility issue: Toast notification in Jobs.svelte (line 362) is a plain div without semantic meaning. Should have role='alert' or role='status' so screen readers announce it. Also consider adding aria-live='polite' for non-urgent notifications.
close_reason: Added role='alert' and aria-live attribute to toast notification in Jobs.svelte. Error toasts use aria-live='assertive' (interrupts immediately), success toasts use aria-live='polite' (waits for pause). This ensures screen readers announce notifications appropriately.

title: Type casting to any masks TypeScript errors
close_reason: Fixed problematic 'as any' type casts: 1) Created ExportJobResult, ImportJobResult, SyncJobResult interfaces in backend/frontend types. 2) Updated JobStatus.result from 'any' to proper union type. 3) Fixed export.ts to use ExportJobResult type assertion instead of 'as any'. 4) Fixed notifications.ts to use proper SmtpConfig, TelegramConfig, etc. type assertions. 5) Fixed JobProgress.svelte to use Record<string, unknown> instead of 'as any'. 6) Updated TestConnectionResponse.instanceInfo and PluginInfo.settings from 'any' to 'Record<string, unknown>'. 7) Added PluginInfo interface and fixed InspectResult.plugins typing.

title: I have no way to cancel a job currently
close_reason: Added job cancellation support: 1) Added cancel API routes for sync and import jobs in backend. 2) Added cancelSync() and cancelImport() API functions in frontend. 3) Updated Jobs.svelte cancel function to handle all job types (backup, sync, restore). 4) Added Cancel button column to jobs table for running/pending jobs.

title: Missing aria-pressed on toggle buttons
description: Accessibility issue: Toggle buttons throughout the UI lack aria-pressed attributes. Examples: Schedules.svelte:1026 (day picker), Schedules.svelte:1090-1098 (options grid), Connections.svelte:495-548 (time format and theme toggles). Screen readers cannot determine selected state. Add aria-pressed='true/false' based on current selection.
close_reason: Added aria-pressed attribute to all toggle buttons: Connections.svelte (time format 12h/24h toggles, theme light/dark/auto toggles) and Import.svelte (restore option section toggles). Also added role='group' and aria-label to toggle button containers for better screen reader context.

title: Generic catch(error: any) blocks throughout codebase
description: Found 60+ instances of generic catch(error: any) blocks with varied error handling. This defeats TypeScript's type safety and makes error handling inconsistent. Examples in: routes/connections.ts (2), routes/export.ts (5), routes/import.ts (4), routes/notifications.ts (9), services/dispatcharrClient.ts (8). Consider creating custom error types and using specific catch handling.

title: Inconsistent result interfaces from service methods
description: Service methods return inconsistent result shapes making calling code fragile. Some return { synced, skipped, errors }, others return { imported, skipped, errors, idMap }, others return { imported, skipped, errors, idMap, groupDetails } as any. Should define consistent interfaces for operation results in types/index.ts.
close_reason: Created standardized result interfaces in types/index.ts: ImportResult, ImportResultWithIdMap, ImportResultWithLogoMap, SyncResult, SyncResultWithLogoMap, AssignmentResult, InspectResult, ExtractResult, CachedUpload, CleanupResult, LogoFileData, SimpleLogoImportResult. Updated all service methods in importService.ts, syncService.ts, exportService.ts, dispatcharrClient.ts, and simpleLogoImport.ts to use these interfaces instead of inline type definitions.

title: Toast timeout memory leak in Jobs component
description: In Jobs.svelte lines 40-50, toastTimeout is set with setTimeout but if the component unmounts while toast is showing, the timeout persists. Toast notification timers can accumulate if multiple jobs complete rapidly. Should clear timeout in onDestroy() lifecycle hook.
close_reason: Fixed toast timeout memory leak in Jobs.svelte by adding clearTimeout(toastTimeout) to onDestroy() callback. This prevents the timeout from firing after component unmount.

title: Missing path traversal protection in ZIP extraction
description: In importService.ts:506-518, there's no validation that extracted file paths stay within the base directory. A malicious ZIP could contain entries like '../../../etc/passwd' that would traverse outside the intended directory. Need to validate that fullPath stays within baseDir after path.join().
close_reason: Added path traversal protection in extractZip function. The fix validates that resolved target paths stay within the extraction directory by checking that they start with the resolved extractDir path. Throws an error if path traversal is detected.

title: Create test fixtures and mock utilities for service tests
description:
Create shared test utilities for mocking services:

**Mock DispatcharrClient** (backend/tests/mocks/dispatcharrClient.ts):
- Mock get/post/put/patch/delete methods
- Configurable response handlers per endpoint
- Support for paginated responses
- Error simulation

**Test fixtures** (backend/tests/fixtures/):
- Sample channel data (channels, streams, groups)
- Sample M3U account data
- Sample EPG source and data
- Sample plugin/user/settings data

**Test helpers** (backend/tests/helpers.ts):
- createMockJobManager() - returns mocked jobManager
- createMockClient(responses) - creates configured mock client
- waitForCondition() - async test utilities

This is a prerequisite for all service tests.

title: Memory leak: uncleaned setInterval in jobManager
description: In jobManager.ts:267, a setInterval runs indefinitely for cleanup but is never cleared. If the service restarts or is patched, multiple intervals could accumulate. No cleanup mechanism exists for service shutdown. Should store interval ID and clear on SIGTERM/SIGINT.
close_reason: Fixed memory leak by moving setInterval into JobManager class. Added cleanupInterval property to track the interval, startCleanupInterval() method that clears existing intervals before creating new one (safe for hot-reload), shutdown() method to clear interval on process exit, and unref() to prevent interval from blocking process exit. Updated index.ts to call jobManager.shutdown() on SIGTERM/SIGINT.

title: Create reusable TimePicker component
description: Time picker logic is embedded in Schedules.svelte (lines 866-1078) and handles 12h/24h format conversion. This could be extracted into a standalone TimePicker.svelte component that's reusable across the application for any time input needs.
close_reason: Moved TimePicker.svelte and DayPicker.svelte from schedule/ subfolder to top-level components/ folder for reusability. Updated import paths in both components and ScheduleFormModal.svelte. Components can now be easily imported by any component needing time or day selection.

title: Replace console.log with proper logging library
description: Found 44+ console.log statements throughout the codebase that should be cleaned up or replaced with a proper logging library (winston, pino). Debug logging should be configurable via environment variable or log level. Key files: dispatcharrClient.ts (13), schedulerService.ts (16), simpleLogoImport.ts (9), jobManager.ts (4), index.ts (4).
close_reason: Replaced all 112 console.log/error/warn statements with pino structured logging. Added logger.ts configuration module with pino-pretty for dev, environment-based log levels (LOG_LEVEL env var), and child loggers via createLogger(). Updated 14 files: index.ts, schedulerService.ts, dispatcharrClient.ts, simpleLogoImport.ts, jobManager.ts, syncService.ts, exportService.ts, importService.ts, notificationService.ts, and routes (export.ts, import.ts, info.ts, schedules.ts, sync.ts).

title: Missing cancellation token support in long-running operations
description: Long-running loops in syncService.ts (waitForEpgData, waitForStreams) and importService.ts don't consistently check for job cancellation. If a job is cancelled during channel import (~line 1111), the operation continues processing. Add throwIfCancelled() checks in all loops to respect user cancellation requests.
close_reason: Added comprehensive cancellation token support: 1) Added throwIfCancelled() method to both syncService.ts and importService.ts. 2) Added cancellation checks in all long-running while loops (waitForEpgData, waitForStreams, getAllPaginated, M3U refresh wait). 3) Added cancellation checks at the start of each major sync/import step. 4) Updated error handling to properly handle cancelled errors without marking jobs as failed.

title: Extract hardcoded magic numbers to constants
description: Many hardcoded timeouts and intervals throughout the codebase should be extracted to a constants file: dispatcharrClient.ts:17 (120000ms HTTP timeout), info.ts:70 (5000ms GitHub timeout), importService.ts:1719 (3000ms delay), Jobs.svelte:30 (3000ms poll), Schedules.svelte:377 (10000ms poll), exportService.ts:482 (15000ms logo timeout). Create backend/src/constants.ts and frontend/src/constants.ts.
close_reason: Extracted hardcoded magic numbers to constants. Created backend/src/constants.ts with 17 numeric constants (timeouts, intervals, page sizes). Added timing constants to frontend/src/constants.ts. Updated 8 backend files (index.ts, routes/info.ts, services/dispatcharrClient.ts, exportService.ts, importService.ts, jobManager.ts, notificationService.ts, syncService.ts) and 5 frontend files (Jobs.svelte, Export.svelte, Import.svelte, Sync.svelte, Schedules.svelte) to use the centralized constants.

title: No file size validation before base64 decoding
description: In importService.ts:194-196, no size validation before converting base64 to buffer. A malicious 10GB base64 string could exhaust memory. Should validate file size before decoding and reject oversized uploads early.
close_reason: Added file size validation before base64 decoding to prevent memory exhaustion attacks. Created safeBase64Decode() helper that estimates decoded size before allocating memory and throws clear error if limit exceeded. Applied to: backup file import/inspect (10GB limit), logo imports (50MB limit per logo). Updated importService.ts and simpleLogoImport.ts.

title: Add rate limiting for API calls to Dispatcharr
description: The code makes many sequential API calls without rate limiting. Could cause issues if the target Dispatcharr server has strict rate limits. No exponential backoff on failures. Consider adding configurable rate limiting and retry logic with exponential backoff.

title: Add unit tests for backend services
description: No test files found in the codebase. The backend services (importService.ts at 2920 lines, syncService.ts at 2046 lines) contain complex business logic that should have unit tests. Consider adding Jest or Vitest with tests for critical paths like error handling, data transformation, and API interactions.
close_reason: Added Vitest test framework with 55 unit tests covering JobManager, ScheduleStore, and NotificationService. Created GitHub Actions workflow (test.yml) for CI and updated docker-build.yml to require tests before building. Tests run on push to main/dev and all PRs to main.

title: Temp files accumulate without cleanup
close_reason: Added comprehensive temp file cleanup: 1) deleteCachedUpload() method to remove cached uploads after use. 2) cleanupStaleTempFiles() method to remove files older than 1 hour from temp/ and upload-cache/. 3) Automatic cleanup of cached uploads after import completes (success or failure). 4) Startup cleanup to remove stale temp files from previous sessions. 5) Periodic cleanup running every hour. 6) Proper shutdown handling for cleanup interval.

title: Hardcoded UI strings duplicated across components
description: UI labels are duplicated in 8+ files: 'Channel Groups' appears in Schedules.svelte:300, Import.svelte:48, OptionsForm.svelte:18. Day names, provider types, and schedule presets are all hardcoded in multiple places. Create frontend/src/i18n.ts or frontend/src/constants.ts with shared label definitions to reduce duplication and enable future internationalization.
close_reason: Duplicate - already fixed in this session

title: console.error misused for debug/info logging
description: In routes/import.ts lines 22, 35, 37, console.error() is being used for info/debug messages like '[INSPECT ROUTE] Received file'. These should use console.log or proper info-level logging instead, as they're not actual errors.
close_reason: Already fixed - console.error calls in routes/import.ts were replaced with proper pino logging (log.debug, log.error) when we converted the entire backend to use pino earlier in this session.

title: Temp files accumulate without cleanup
description: In importService.ts:487-497, temp file cleanup is in a try-catch that swallows errors. If temp files can't be deleted, they accumulate on disk. No periodic cleanup of orphaned temp directories exists. Should implement proper finally blocks and periodic cleanup.
close_reason: Duplicate - already fixed in this session

title: Add authentication layer to DBAS
description: The DBAS tool itself has no authentication layer - anyone with network access can use it. This is a security concern for non-LAN deployments. Consider adding optional basic auth or JWT authentication that can be enabled via environment variables.

title: Debug console.log statements in frontend production code
description: Debug logs left in production code: App.svelte:13 'console.log(App component init)', main.ts:26 'console.log(Mounting App...)', Import.svelte:112-113 'console.error([FRONTEND] Received sections...)'. These should be removed or wrapped in development-only conditionals.
close_reason: Removed debug console.log statements from frontend production code. Removed console.log('App component init') from App.svelte, console.log('Mounting App') from main.ts, and 3 console.error debug statements from Import.svelte. Kept legitimate console.warn calls for actual error handling.

title: Silent error swallowing in API catch blocks
description: Multiple locations use .catch(() => []) which silently swallows errors without logging. This makes debugging very difficult when API calls fail. Examples: importService.ts:332-944, syncService.ts:46-50. Errors should be logged to jobManager before returning empty arrays.
close_reason: Added warnOnFail() helper method to both importService.ts and syncService.ts that logs API failures with context (endpoint, status, message) to jobManager (if jobId available) and console.warn. Updated getAllPaginated() in both services to accept optional jobId for error logging. Replaced all 49 instances of silent .catch(() => []) and .catch(() => null) patterns with proper error logging while maintaining graceful degradation behavior.

title: Add spinners to all loading states for consistency
description: Some loading states have spinners while others only show text. Missing spinners: Schedules.svelte:641 ('Loading schedules...'), Schedules.svelte:1145 (history loading), Notifications.svelte:296 (loading message). Add consistent spinner component across all loading states.
close_reason: Added spinners to all loading states for consistency. Updated 5 loading messages across 4 files (Connections.svelte, Notifications.svelte x2, Schedules.svelte, ScheduleHistoryModal.svelte) to include spinner animation alongside the text, matching the pattern used in Jobs.svelte.

title: Unbounded Map growth in Jobs component
description: In Jobs.svelte:25, previousJobStatuses Map grows unbounded and is never cleared if jobs persist for long sessions. Should implement cleanup of old entries or limit map size to prevent memory issues during long-running sessions.
close_reason: Fixed potential unbounded Map growth by only tracking jobs in active states (pending/running). Completed, failed, and cancelled jobs are filtered out since they won't change status. This ensures the Map only contains entries that are actively being monitored for status changes.

title: Schedules.svelte is too large (1577 lines) - needs refactoring
description: Schedules.svelte is 1577 lines and should be broken into smaller components: 1) ScheduleList.svelte - table display and actions (lines 614-742), 2) ScheduleForm.svelte - create/edit form (lines 745-1126), 3) TimePicker.svelte - reusable time selection (lines 866-1078), 4) ScheduleManager.ts - business logic service. This would improve maintainability and make TimePicker reusable.
close_reason: Refactored Schedules.svelte from 1579 lines to 461 lines (71% reduction). Extracted: 1) scheduleUtils.ts - cron parsing/building, time formatting utilities. 2) TimePicker.svelte - reusable time input with 12h/24h support. 3) DayPicker.svelte - day of week selector. 4) ScheduleFormModal.svelte - complete create/edit modal. 5) ScheduleHistoryModal.svelte - run history display. All components are in frontend/src/components/schedule/ directory.

title: Toast timeout memory leak in Jobs component
close_reason: Fixed toast timeout memory leak in Jobs.svelte by adding clearTimeout(toastTimeout) to onDestroy() callback. This prevents the timeout from firing after component unmount.

title: Modals missing aria-labelledby
description: Accessibility issue: Schedules.svelte:747 modal has aria-modal='true' but missing aria-labelledby linking to header. Screen readers need this to announce the modal title when it opens. Add id to modal header and aria-labelledby to modal container.
close_reason: Added aria-labelledby to all 12 modals across 9 component files (Connections, Export, Import, Jobs, Notifications, PluginUploadModal, ScheduleFormModal, ScheduleHistoryModal, Sync). Each modal's h3 title now has a unique id that is referenced by aria-labelledby on the dialog container, enabling screen readers to announce the modal title when it opens.

title: Credentials may be logged in error messages
description: In importService.ts:77-85 and 108-116, error details include request config which may contain passwords. While there's a redact() function (lines 88-101), it's only used for config.data in some paths. If an error response contains credentials in the body, they could be logged unredacted. Audit all error logging paths.
close_reason: Added comprehensive credential redaction: 1) Enhanced redact() function in importService.ts with broader sensitive key patterns (password, token, secret, apikey, auth, bearer, jwt, session, cookie). 2) Added redactString() to handle JSON strings and key=value patterns. 3) Applied redaction to all string data in formatErrorDetails(). 4) Added redactObject(), redactString(), and safeStringify() utilities to dispatcharrClient.ts. 5) Fixed all console.log/error calls that could leak credentials in auth errors, POST/PATCH payloads, and error response data.
